exposure: practice of physical activity (PA) according to the gestational trimesters
finding: Puerperal women who did not practice PA in the third trimester of pregnancy were more likely to have cesarean delivery and low birth weight newborns.
mod_finding: Puerperal women who did not practice PA in the third trimester of pregnancy were more likely to have cesarean delivery
birth_weight: low birth weight defined as < 2,500 grams
